_comment: Tier-2 for febio::damage#2, syntax half. <Dmax>1.0</Dmax> is accepted and runs; 1.2 and -0.1 are rejected AFTER the deck reads SUCCESS, with 'Invalid value for parameter:' followed by '.Dmax' — the fixture asserts the name before the dot is EMPTY (i.e. 'Material1.Dmax' does not appear), because that is the detail that stops a reader searching for a material name. The mesh-dependent softening half of that pitfall is NOT asserted here and is named as uncovered. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'dmax_range_check=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
